scope: Operator assembly, quadrature diagnostics, helper equivalence, linear solver and storage verification only. These records do not establish boundary-density resolution or physical pair accuracy.
recorded_pose: Fixed failed AR20 orientations; h150 nm only. No other AR or table generation.
backend_scope: Mixed historical plumbing checks. Original seven records use the original pinned build; mmap_chunked_p4_check uses the patched build recorded in its metadata; mmap_chunked_p6_check uses the original build to compare saved density. None qualifies the physical reference.
source_snapshot_note: Original JSON records are preserved byte-for-byte. Some records do not contain a source-file hash; no current source hash is substituted for a historical verification hash.

records.interpretation: Default upstream far quadrature on the coarse p4/l0 AR20 mesh differs from dense by 6.258e-4; this is retained failure evidence, not a passing solver check.
Same coarse mesh: all-patches-near FMM add/subtract agrees to 5.11e-11; adding eight far orders improves but does not resolve the default far-quadrature discrepancy.
Explicit far-order refinement 0,16,32,48 monotonically reduces the coarse-mesh discrepancy; eps alone is not an achieved-error certificate.
Same recorded AR20 h150 nm, p6/l1 N2352: all-near matvec versus dense 2.21e-15; patch-GMRES solution versus dense 5.82e-9.
Exact body-self inverse errors about2e-15; mixed RHS converges in300 iterations. This is no guarantee of fast convergence on refined meshes.
Same recorded AR20 h150 nm, p4/l0 N300: fused-helper matvec and all17 matmat match dense to floating-point roundoff.
Same recorded AR20 h150 nm, p6/l1 N2352: all17 mmap solutions equal ordinary dense exactly, LU aliases mmap, residual1.33e-13, temporary files removed.
Patched backend, same recorded AR20 h150 nm p4/l0 N300: target-chunked complete matrix equals native full matgen exactly; full17 residual4.55e-14.
Original backend, same recorded AR20 h150 nm p6/l1 N2352: all17 target-chunked solutions agree with saved native dense density to2.29e-15; residual1.33e-13. No new baseline assembly needed.

Synthetic SPD matrix with dimension3000 and17 RHS: shared and COW solutions coincide, original A remains unchanged, and strict private-memory guard/cleanup tests pass. Does not predict N9963 performance or qualify any physical reference.

Four storage/error-path tests pass. Admission may proceed to assembly when nominal factor capacity fits, but actual LU headroom still rejects factorization if insufficient. No active-file cache credit or reserve weakening.

resource_failure_history: The original monolithic mmap assembly passed N2352 equivalence but was OOM-killed at N9963 under an8GiB cgroup. Target-chunked v2 assembly supersedes that resource strategy. Small-mesh equivalence is not proof of large-mesh resource feasibility.
